name: Furious Flame
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: Religious sigils of Scal carefully carved into the doorframe capture Tokainen's suppressed anger and frustration, unleashing it in a destructive explosion when a creature attempts to open the door.
disable: DC 26 Thievery (expert) to scratch out the religious iconography, DC 24 Religion (trained) to pray for safe passage, DC 28 Diplomacy (expert) to soothe the emotions powering the magical ward, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the magical energy

offensiveAbilities.name: Furious Explosion
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the door directly or with a tool; Bypass key

Effect The trap explodes in a 15-foot radius burst, dealing 5d10 Fire Damage damage to all creatures in the area (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures damaged by the trap must additionally succeed at a Basic DC 26 Will Saving Throw save (against a mental effect), becoming Confused for 1 minute on a failure.
